title: Card documents a position: relative that no stylesheet sets
foundBy: an independent reviewer agent, one of three asked whether each component specification still describes the component that exists
details:
`components/Card.md:60` gives the Card root `display: block` and `position: relative`.

`src/styles/components/card.css` contains no `position` declaration at all. The root class sets overflow, radius, border and shadow only.

A consumer who absolutely positions a badge or a menu inside a Card, on the strength of that line, gets it positioned against whichever ancestor does establish a containing block. That is usually the page rather than the card.
